title: Binance Adds DOGE/TUSD, USDT/ARS & WBTC/USDT Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for the DOGE/TUSD and WBTC/USDT trading pairs at  2023-04-28 08:00 (UTC),  and the USDT/ARS trading pair at  2023-04-28 12:00 (UTC) . Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Binance Spot Grid will be enabled for the DOGE/TUSD and WBTC/USDT trading pairs within 48 hours of the trading start time.   Start Grid Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes:  Users will enjoy zero maker fees on the DOGE/TUSD trading pair until further notice. ARS is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-04-27   Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram   Note: This announcement was last updated on 2023-04-28 to clarify that users will enjoy zero maker fees on the DOGE/TUSD trading pair until further notice.
